decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The application for the proposed Replacement of the existing ground floor front bow window with a bay window and replacement of the existing two first floor windows with new windows, as shown on the unnumbered drawings, received 14 August 2006, satisfactorily complies with the relevant UDP policies as it would be compatible with the scale, character and form of the original building, would maintain the amenity of neighbouring properties and have no negative impact on the existing street scene in the area.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
description: Replacement of the existing ground floor front bow window with a bay window and replacement of the existing two first floor windows with new to the existing house.
